name: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID
notes: Preliminary v0.1.1: the native Android client of GitHub Actions Monitor. It reads the routes of a monitor in network mode with its access token (and, in the team mode, the session of a person), both kept sealed in the Android Keystore, and shows the summary, the alerts, the repositories and the proposals of its AI, read only (the monitor accepts approval only on its own computer). The client is tested on the JVM against answers recorded from a demo monitor and against running demo monitors, and the screens are pictured in an emulator. The release APK is built by a manual GitHub Actions workflow and signed by the maintainer; the app has not been run on a phone yet.
